name: graph-propagate
description: Graph-first reverse engineering for legacy systems (Reversa fork with graphify). Codex agents query a graphify knowledge graph of the code before reading files, so analysis runs faster with far fewer tokens. graphify is installed automatically on first run; choose AST (free, local) or semantic graphs.
author: Aman (fork of Reversa by sandeco)

graphify.install: auto: uv tool install graphifyy | pipx install graphifyy | python3 -m pip install --user graphifyy
graphify.graphLocation: .reversa/graphify-out/ (or a read-only graphify-out/ at the project root)
graphify.modes: ast (default, free, local) | semantic (LLM, richer INFERRED edges)
graphify.usedBy: Scout, Archaeologist, Detective, Architect, Data Master, Reviewer, Migration team, Bugs team
